# Porvenir Agencia Digital

> Software Engineering and UX Design agency specialized in AI Automation and High-Conversion Web Development.

## Overview
Porvenir Agencia Digital, based in Ciudad Real (Spain), bridges the gap between complex Software Engineering and human-centric UX Design. Led by Teresa Rodríguez de Dios (Software Engineer & UX Expert), the agency focuses on business efficiency through AI and strategic digital presence.

## Core Services
- **AI Automation & Chatbots:** Development of intelligent B2B/B2C agents using LLMs for 24/7 customer support and sales automation via WhatsApp and Web.
- **High-Conversion Web Design:** Bespoke, high-performance websites optimized for SEO and conversion, built with engineering rigour.
- **UX & Accessibility Audits:** Technical evaluations and implementation of WCAG 2.1 compliance to avoid legal risks and improve inclusive usability.
- **AI Training for Companies:** In-company workshops focused on practical AI implementation to increase team productivity.

## Key Technical Differentiators
- **Engineering Foundation:** Projects are approached from a software engineering perspective (performance, scalability, clean code), not just aesthetic design.
- **UX-First Strategy:** Every technical solution is validated through User Experience principles.
- **AI Ethics & Compliance:** Specialized in EU AI Act alignment and data governance.

## Key Personnel
- **Teresa Rodríguez de Dios:** Founder, Software Engineer, and UX Expert.

## Contact & Location
- **Main Location:** Ciudad Real, Spain.
- **Serving:** Madrid, Seville, Toledo, Malaga, and International clients.
